description: This file defines the controller class 'jjwg_MarkersController' for handling marker map views in the jjwg_Markers module of a SugarCRM project. It contains methods for rendering marker edit and detail map views, retrieving marker data based on request parameters.

classes.name: jjwg_MarkersController
classes.description: Controller class handling map marker views, extending SugarController with methods for editing and viewing marker details.

methods.name: action_marker_edit_map
methods.description: Sets up the view for editing a marker on the map, retrieving marker info if a valid 'id' is provided.

methods.name: action_marker_detail_map
methods.description: Sets up the view for displaying marker details on the map, retrieving marker info if a valid 'id' is provided.
